meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把目标拆解成有依据的步骤并循环推进
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望按步骤推进目标并留有证据
copy.tagline_en: Break down goals into evidence-bound steps and loop them
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want step-by-step goal tracking with evidence.

howto.what: 把一个大目标拆成按顺序执行的小步骤,每步完成都要给出可查的证据,并持续跟踪进度;涉及改代码、测试、审核时,会自动分派给子代理处理,自己协调全局。
howto.when: 当你提到“ulw-loop”或“ulw”等关键词,或要求长期、有证据、需人工检查的目标执行时触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 把“搭建一个博客网站”拆成步骤执行
say.note: 会先读取完整流程,再逐步拆分并跟踪证据。

say.text: 用 ulw 启动一个需要人工 QA 的长期任务
say.note: 会按流程执行,涉及测试与审核时分派子代理。

say.text: 继续之前的 ulw-loop 目标,从上次断点接着做
say.note: 会先恢复上下文和目标状态,不从头重来。

howto.what_en: Breaks a large goal into ordered, evidence-bound micro-steps and tracks them in a live checklist. Delegates code edits, tests, fixes and QA to subagents, coordinates merges, and resumes from checkpoints after context loss.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions 'ulw-loop'/'ulw', or asks for durable goal execution, evidence-led work, manual QA, or checkpointed long-running delivery.

say_en.text: Run ulw-loop to break 'build a blog site' into steps.
say_en.note: It reads the full workflow, then decomposes and tracks evidence.

say_en.text: Start a ulw goal with manual QA required.
say_en.note: It follows the loop and delegates QA to subagents.

say_en.text: Resume my previous ulw-loop goal from its last checkpoint.
say_en.note: It reloads context and goal state, not from scratch.
